The old harbour town woke slowly each morning.
Fishermen hauled their nets onto the grey stones.
Nobody suspected what the tide would bring.
A crafty question reached the mayor one evening.
He read the letter twice beside the lantern.
Every word seemed to hide another meaning.
By midnight he had made up his mind.
The hated slitter arrived on the first ferry.
Children hid behind the market stalls.
His knives glittered in the cold light.
